problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of differentiable convex component functions and their convex average. Strong convexity is not assumed.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: The objective is f(x) = (1/n) ∑ᵢ lossᵢ(x), with n ≥ 1.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query chooses an index i and point x and returns exactly ∇lossᵢ(x), independently of oracle history and seed. Each component-gradient evaluation costs one call; a full gradient costs n calls. Function values are not supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/InterpolatedGeneralizedFiniteSum.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible oracle-answer clause; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: Each component has continuous gradient and satisfies ‖∇lossᵢ(x) − ∇lossᵢ(y)‖ ≤ (L0 + L1 M)‖x − y‖ whenever its gradient norm is at most M throughout [x,y]. Public parameters satisfy L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0; global Lipschitz smoothness is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/InterpolatedGeneralizedFiniteSum.lean: ComponentSmooth; spec.admissible continuity clause; spec.valid and spec.publicInput.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Interpolation: all components share a global minimizer xstar with ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R. The positive radius R, starting point x0, n, smoothness parameters, and ε > 0 are public. The component functions and common minimizer are hidden; neither optimal function values nor a strong-growth condition is supplied.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/InterpolatedGeneralizedFiniteSum.lean: Instance; spec.admissible common-minimizer clause; spec.Public, spec.publicInput, and spec.valid.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x with f(x) − f(xstar) ≤ ε, where xstar is a common global minimizer of every component.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee must hold with probability at least 2/3 under the algorithm–oracle seed law, within the fixed supplied component-gradient budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines convex finite-sum optimization with componentwise gradient-dependent smoothness and an exact common-minimizer assumption. This is a meaningful variant of the classical globally smooth finite-sum formulation.
